claims.claim_ar: تكرار أداة الربط + اسم الموصول «وَالَّذِينَ» في بداية العبارتين لإحداث توازي بلاغي وتوكيد الجمع المقصود
claims.claim_en: Repetition (takrar) of the conjunction+relative «وَالَّذِينَ» at the start of the two clauses to create syntactic parallelism and emphasize the grouped actors
claims.rhetorical_effect: strengthens rhythm and foregrounds the community of believers by repeating the same opening formula

claims.claim_ar: مقابلة/تغاير بين مجموعتين من الأنصار (المهاجرون/المانحون والمناصرون) بوضعهما في تركيب متوازي يؤكد التكامل بين العمل والدعم
claims.claim_en: Parallel pairing (muqabalah/contrast) of two groups — those who believed, emigrated, and strove in God's way versus those who gave shelter and aided — presented in parallel to show complementary roles
claims.needs_review_reason: interpretive choice between labeling this as muqabalah (contrast) vs plain syntactic parallelism; verify with classical commentaries
claims.rhetorical_effect: highlights complementary forms of commitment (personal sacrifice vs. support), producing a balanced moral portrait of the faithful

claims.claim_ar: التفات من تعداد الأفعال إلى حكم إسمي وتصريحي بـ «أُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقَّاً» — تحول من الوصف إلى التثبيت والقطع
claims.claim_en: Iltifat (shift) from enumerating actions to a nominal affirmation: 'Those — they are the true believers' — a turn from descriptive list to definitive identification and affirmation
claims.needs_review_reason: check whether classical rhetoricians treat this syntactic move as iltifat or as standard nominative summary
claims.rhetorical_effect: gives concluding weight and certitude to the preceding actions by converting them into a fixed identity

claims.claim_ar: إيجاز بلاغي: جمع في جملة قصيرة بين أفعال متعددة (الإيمان/الهجرة/الجهاد/الإيواء/النصرة) والنتيجة الجزائية (المغفرة والرزق الكريم) بوضوح ووجازة
claims.claim_en: Conciseness (ijaaz): the verse compresses multiple actions (belief, migration, striving, sheltering, aiding) and their recompense (forgiveness and noble provision) into a short, potent expression
claims.needs_review_reason: diagnosis tentative: classical sources should be checked for explicit ijaaz attribution for this verse
claims.rhetorical_effect: conveys moral economy and decisive theological reward with minimal wording

warnings: The provided source_chunks are from Zamakhshari, Safi, and others — not the specific classical rhetoricians listed (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha). Claims use available chunks as quoted evidence; consult the named rhetoricians for authoritative labels.

Some device assignments (e.g., muqabalah vs simple parallelism; ijaaz) are interpretive and marked with lower confidence or needs_review_reason. Verify against canonical rhetorical commentaries for final K-Map labeling.
